gpu_tip: ~38GB total at 128K context, and the rung bartowski recommends as the general-purpose default. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) plus a 48GB DDR5 kit is enough, with llama.cpp's layer offloading filling in the gap.
mac_tip: Needs ~38GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) comfortably.
